completion_gate: Reuse check and material difference documented
Actual supported consumer implemented and evaluated, not helper-only
Chronology/maturity and future-perturbation or equivalent leakage failure cases checked
All declared controls and matched/native all-68 coverage reported
Per-target paired MAE/MSE/bias and per-origin/day support reported without confirmation claims
Same-task review and compact reproducible handoff completed; independent review status separate
deliverable: Select one justified existing method with usable artifacts/dependencies, distinguish recovery from new fitting, and complete the matched chronological comparison.
hypothesis: One recovered, substantively different model mechanism adds predictive value on the current target/support beyond ridge/HGB.
limits: One material candidate at a time, with measured fit/memory/time limits. No install/service/API work, exhaustive model sweep or duplicate experiment.

resource_estimate.basis: Measure from retained analogous recipes and actual support before a compute launch.

retry_policy: Retry a blocked/failed experiment only after recording a changed dependency or a concrete repair; do not rerun completed negative results unchanged.
support_check: Recover exact target/input/fit provenance first; use existing installed dependencies. Reject future-trained weights in earlier historical replay. Record unavailable candidate mechanisms separately and select a supported alternative.
